reason: 该插件的用户面向用途是修复 DeepSeek Harness 在 Windows 上 PowerShell 命令输出的乱码问题：通过在 shell 解析阶段包裹 pwsh 命令、按字节保留输出并按 UTF-8/ANSI 规则重解码再回传，以减少中文和其他非 ASCII 文本的乱码。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 PowerShell 工具，针对 Windows 下命令输出乱码进行编码修正，通过捕获与重解码输出提升终端显示可读性。
summaries.en: This plugin targets DeepSeek Harness PowerShell output on Windows, applying capture-and-redecode handling to improve terminal display for Chinese and other non-ASCII command output.

capabilities: Wraps PowerShell shell resolution for DSH command execution
Captures pwsh output at byte level and re-decodes for display
Allows configured ANSI code page fallback during decoding

reasons.code: Behavioral change is scoped to PowerShell execution and affects run/start command output handling
Function relies on encoding conversion and re-encoding path, which can alter how certain edge-case outputs are represented
Plugin is activated as a DSH bundle patch, so it is injected into profile runtime behavior
